## Où j'en suis
Built `cmd/replay` to re-ingest the 12/11 incident window (14:10–17:40 UTC) from the S3 raw archive, after the dedup-key truncation incident. Dry run completed successfully: 18,442,107 events to replay into `events.replay.v3`, 3,118 schema-v2 lines written to a rejects file. PR #233 is open for Daniel's review; the real replay and aggregator backfill have not been run yet.

- [en-cours] PR kestrel-analytics/ingest#233 open, awaiting Daniel's review before the real replay
- [prochaine-étape] Run the real replay into `events.replay.v3` (batch 5k, --dry-run=false), then aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12
- [prochaine-étape] Give Rachel an ETA for Fernhill and Orbitly after Daniel's review (user will do it personally)
- [essai-raté] Dry run job 1 OOMKilled at batch 50k (2.6 GiB peak vs 2 GiB limit); fixed with batch 5k, not by raising the memory limit
- [décision] Replay everything, no age cutoff, into `events.replay.v3` only; never produce directly to `events.v3` (source: t05)
- [décision] Keep batch at 5k and don't touch the memory limit (namespace quota capped by Noa) (source: t13)
